Message:
Yelling that,
the guards circled around Ayse.

Killing intruders is the law.
If I do not do something,
Ayse will be...

I jumped in front of Ayse
right away.
Everyone glared at me.

I-I am scared.
But...Ayse is my friend!
I will protect her,
no matter what!

“Hmph! What a waste...!
And just when I had you
good and fooled, too.”

I turned around,
and Ayse was looking
at me with cold eyes.

“Did you really think
the likes of you could
ever become friends with
someone like me?”
